policy: For each task, test one case at a time at each level; advance after five valid solved answers. Stop increasing that task at its first model failure, including a prior baseline failure. Preserve and distinguish illegal actions, unsolved plans, output-contract failures and truncation. Retry only infrastructure failures; stop unresolved service slots after the service policy is exhausted. Rotate among tasks after each case. Finite configured ranges are guards, not a claim that an error must occur. If all ranges pass, report range_exhausted without inventing a breakpoint. Do not modify the original 40-case suites or resample model failures.
